What we confirmed on official pages

  • Assessment notices go out in June; taxes on that assessment due December 20 (from the county site listing; confirm with the office)
  • Due dates December 20 (1st half) and June 20 (2nd half); notice mailed no later than 4th Monday in November
  • Late: 2% late charge added; interest 12% annually starting January 1 (2nd half interest back-dates to January 1)
  • Returned check fee $20; no formal monthly payment plan
  • Personal property/manufactured housing: if first half unpaid by Dec 20, entire tax delinquent; Warrant of Distraint issued to Sheriff

Owner-occupancy is 75%, so renters hold about 25% of occupied homes. The median home was built in 1998, about 25 years ago.
